descriptions: Added a full visual Theme Editor, opened from a button in the Emote Editor. colors.css is retired — everything now runs through the Theme Editor.
Themes save server-side to theme.json and push live to everyone instantly. Only admins can save, and no restart is needed.

Automatic migration: on first start after updating, the script converts your existing colors.css to theme.json (you'll see 'migrated colors.css -> theme.json' in the console). Base colours, header colour, glow, and all nine emote wheel colours transfer automatically.
Nine editable components with their own tabs: Normal Menu, Big Menu, Header, Cards, Categories, Settings, Emote Wheel, Help Bar, and Dialogs. Set a base look once, then override any component.

Per component: edit accent/surface/border/text colours, use solid or gradient fills with stop control, adjust border radius/width/glow/font scale, toggle per-component blur with a strength slider, and customize the outer frame border independently.
Hover and active states are fully themeable, with a Normal/Hover toggle in the preview.
Live preview built from the real menu's markup — what you see is exactly what the menu looks like.
9 preset themes included: Original, Bablo's Favorite, Vision, Midnight, Crimson, Synthwave, Carbon, Abyss, and Emerald. You can also share/import theme codes or reset to default.
Real game blur — panels blur the actual game world behind them instead of faking it, with strength tiers for quality vs. performance.
Added 'play an emote together' — middle-click any normal emote to ask the closest player to play it with you. They get an accept/deny prompt; on accept, you both play it at the same time.
Added 15 brand-new custom shared couple emotes to expand the shared emote library out of the box.
Added a few missing flag emotes to round out the flag emote collection.
The Emote Editor can now hide built-in categories from the player menu.
Added registerEmote export — external animation tools can register emotes straight into your emote files, including a customMovementType option.
Added Config.HelpBarPosition — position the key hints at the bottom, top, left, or right. Side positions stack the hints vertically.
Added Config.AnimPosGizmoMaxRadius — caps how far /animpos can drag a ped from its starting point.
Removed /emotecreator command — /emoteeditor is now the single command.
Fixed gradients breaking the panel border — the fill used to paint under the ring, turning the edge into a colour band instead of a border.
Fixed ox_lib help text to show the real keybinds instead of generic text, and to appear when placing an animation.
Fixed statebag warnings on servers running strict mode.
Fixed the emote wheel not recolouring with the theme.
Fixed the Normal Menu's colours bleeding into the Help Bar or Big Menu — each now has its own tab and stays on it.
